notes.title: Test 0.9 - Early version
notes.content:
As promised we have started working on localizing the game to a multitude of languages. Right now these languages are added on the preview branch:
[list]
[*]English
[*]Dutch
[*]Portuguese
[*]Spanish
[*]Simplified Chinese
[/list]

While we are working with the proper professionals to translate and test all elements of the game we want to incorporate your feedback as well, especially for the Portuguese and Spanish localization, since we feel that these ones are really close to being completed. 

If you want to test the early versions feel free to switch your game version to the early testing branch and select your desired language in the steam options menu:
[olist]
[*] Right click Verbal Verdict in your Steam library
[*] Click on properties
[*] Click on Betas
[*] Select preview in the dropdown menu
[*] Click on General 
[*] Select your desired language
[/olist]

[b]Do not forget to switch back when you are done testing![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839392/fa0dc1208a1c887063f12c1d234169f63be49a66.gif[/img]

[i]Things are expected to be broken, break or otherwise. Please keep this in mind.[/i]

Feel free to provide feedback in the [u]comments[/u] of this post or send us an email: [u]verbalverdict@savannadevelopments.com[/u]. We hope to ship the update of 0.9 to you soon and provide more details about 0.10 in the near future.

[u]The Savanna Team[/u]

notes.title: Future - What's next for Verbal Verdict
notes.content:
Thank you all so much for playing and enjoying the game. Development of the game hasn't settled down and we are working towards a 0.9 update, and are happy to announce 0.10 and how this will work.

[h1]0.9 - Performance and Localization[/h1]

For 0.9 we plan to add support for multiple languages to the game. Right now Spanish and Portuguese are planned because of popular demand. [i]Please note that this can still change based on performance / behavior of the AI models.[/i] But we are still exploring the addition of other languages. 

We also started on the groundwork for 0.10. This work allows us to already port some of this work to 0.9. This has the result that the game requires a little bit less memory and loading screens now should take less time. This results in slightly better performance overall.

[h1]0.10 - What will we add?[/h1]

For 0.10 we want to make moves towards a bigger gameplay experience. Without revealing too much the game will be split into a "story" like mode and a mode where you can (re)play different cases. This "story" like mode will result in a complete story while keeping the core experience available. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839392/e40795c1367d12f925e9f952969e0e0efc29356e.png[/img]

notes.title: 0.8 - Audio Update & New Cases!
notes.content:
Hello Detectives!

We are thrilled to announce that update 0.8 is now live. This update significantly enhances the game's audio experience while also improving user interaction with menus and buttons. Additionally, we are introducing new cases and experimental features with this update.

[h3]AUDIO[/h3]

The primary focus of this update is to enhance the game's audio, aiming to provide a more polished gaming experience. To achieve this, we have worked on incorporating sound effects and introducing a feature to give suspects a true voice!

[list]
[*]  Added sounds for most, if not all, evidence board items. These sounds can vary from simple effects on location maps to full voice-overs of statements and sticky notes.
[*] Added EXPERIMENTAL ElevenLabs API support. With this feature, you can now have all suspects use normal generated voices. Please note that using this functionality requires an ElevenLabs API key and an active internet connection. Follow [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3213356838]this guide[/url] for a step-by-step walkthrough on how to set it up.
[*] Added ElevenLabs voices for each suspect.
[/list]

[h3]CASES[/h3]

With this update, we are introducing two new cases to the game, bringing the total to six. This amounts to more than three hours of content for players to explore and solve! We eagerly await your feedback on these cases. If you have any thoughts, please let us know!

[list]
[*] Added "The Manuscript" case
[*] Added  "Walter" case
[*] Added "NEW" badge to new cases that have been added in the latest update.
[/list]

[h3]GUI[/h3]

We've also made some changes to the game's UI. This was done to enhance the overall user experience and ensure that the menus better fit the game's style.

[list]
[*] Reworked the settings menu to have separate pages for each subject (Audio, Gameplay, Experimental).
[*] Added Dynamic Cursor coloring. When the cursor hovers over something white it will turn black and vise versa.
[*] Updated the visuals of the GPU Warning. All other warnings and pop-ups will also use this same style.
[/list]

[h3]OTHER FIXES[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the calendar didn't work when exiting the play screen and clicking back into it.
[*] Removed abbreviations like Dr. and Mr. from suspect prompts and replaced them with their full word.
[/list]

We hope you'll enjoy these new features and the addition of new cases. If you have any feedback, please feel free to email us at support@savannadevelopments.com or create a topic on the discussion page.

[u]The Savanna Team[/u]

notes.title: 0.6.1 - Demo bug fixes and additonal features
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone that has played the demo!
We are working hard on resolving all issues and making the game better!

With this update we introduced a popup message for players with a GPU that is not supported for our game. If you get this message please be aware that the game might not work correctly and expect longer loading screens and slower response times. We are constantly adding more GPU's to our supported list if possible, so let us know if the game works for you even if you got the popup message.

Small additions to the game:
[list]
[*] Added warning for players with unsupported graphics card.
[*] Local AI server now shuts down and restarts correctly.
[*] Added indicator when talking with suspects and waiting on a response.
[*] Reworked some suspect persona's.
[*] General bug fixing / issue resolving.
[/list]

Please report any new or recurring issues to us. Contact support@savannadevelopments.com

[u]The Savanna Team[/u]

notes.title: Demo is out now! 🔎
notes.content:
Hey Detectives,

Great news coming your way from the alleys of 1950's Brooklyn – the [b]demo for "Verbal Verdict" is officially live on Steam[/b] and ready for you to play! We at Savanna Developments are filled with excitement to finally let you have a first taste of the mysteries waiting to be unraveled.

In "Verbal Verdict," your intuition, detective skills, and talent for asking the right questions are your tools to climb the ranks from a novice to a seasoned investigator. Our game, powered by the latest in AI technology, is designed to challenge your problem-solving abilities and immerse you in the atmospheric world of vintage detective work.

[b]What's in the Demo?[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]A Sneak Peek into the Mystery:[/b] Get hands-on with an exclusive case.
[*] [b]AI-Powered Interrogations:[/b] Test your wits against our sophisticated AI characters.
[*] [b]1950's Brooklyn:[/b] Feel the vibe of the era that sets the perfect backdrop for your investigations.
[/list]

[b]How to Get Started:[/b]
Ready to put on your detective hat? Jump over to our Steam page, find "Verbal Verdict," and hit that download button on the demo. Begin your journey into the heart of Brooklyn's most intriguing cases right now.

[b]We Want Your Feedback![/b]
[i]The game is still in early access![/i]
Your thoughts and feedback are invaluable to us. They help polish and perfect the gameplay, ensuring "Verbal Verdict" meets the high standards we set and you expect. So please, after you've played the demo, share your impressions, suggestions, and any bugs you might encounter in the Community Hub. Your input directly influences the game's development path.

[u]The Savanna Team[/u]
